title: fix(app-shell): record breadcrumb names the object while the record is read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6v19uPsX6gX42G8tGcvvzb)_
Fixes #35412

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：在业务应用（如「销售」）的「待我审批」里打开一条审批，现在留在该应用里，应用名和左侧菜单都不变；处理完后自动打开的下一条也留在该应用里。打开任何记录时，页面上方的路径在加载中显示对象名（如「审批请求」），不再闪出内部编号。
- 为什么：以前会跳进「系统设置」应用，业务用户处理完审批就找不到自己的应用了；内部编号对用户没有意义，看起来像出错。
- 如果判断错：只影响打开审批时落在哪个应用、以及路径上的文字；审批本身的通过和驳回不受影响。从首页、通知、邮件打开审批的落点没有改，另卡处理。
- 需要您做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

This PR carries items 1 and 3 of the card, and pins that "open next" stays in the app. Item 2 (opens with no source app: Home, notifications, email links) is split to its own card and is unchanged here.

- **The record page's breadcrumb never shows the raw id while the record is read** (generic, every object). `RecordDetailView`'s crumb 「OBJECT › RECORD」 drew `#` plus the short id until the read landed. Until the page holds the route's record it now draws the object's label (「审批请求」 for `sys_approval_request`); once it does, the record's title, resolved in the same render, so the frame that lands the record already names it. A loaded record that nothing names keeps its short id, as before.
- **A title belongs to the record it was resolved for.** The page stays mounted when it steps (↓ ↑, `j` / `k`, and the approvals queue's 「open the next one」), and `pageRecord` is not cleared at the start of the next read. The title was held loose, so during the next read the crumb named the new record with the old one's title, and the favourite label, the "Recently Accessed" entry and the pane bar's reported title were written under the new record with that title. The title is now keyed by `object:id`, and the page records which record `pageRecord` holds (`pageRecordFor`), so nothing names the route's record from the record left behind.
- **Item 1, see the section below.**
- **"Open next" keeps the app.** `siblingRecordStep` renames only the record segment, so a request opened under an app keeps that app when the next one opens, and the last one returns to that app's inbox. A new pin holds this for a business app's component inbox (`/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/component/approvals/inbox`).

The phone app bar's own record title (`AppHeader`'s `#` fallback) is untouched: on a phone the console mounts no app bar on a record route, and from `sm` up that label is hidden.

## Item 1

- **The inbox's row open (`openRequest` in the Console's `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`) opens a request in the app the inbox is mounted in** whenever the inbox route has an app segment: `/apps/CURRENT/sys_approval_request/record/ID`, from the component inbox (`approvals:inbox`) and from `system/approvals` alike. It used to ask `requestPagePath`, which picks the app whose navigation lists the record's object, else Setup; that sent a business app's 「待我审批」 into the Setup app.
- **Unchanged:** `RequestDeepLink` and `requestPagePath` (the `?request=ID` deep link that Home, notifications and email links use, which still opens under the record-owning app, else Setup); an inbox with no app segment; the record card on the request page, which still links the record under the app that owns it (pinned in `record-pointer-card-renderer.test.tsx`).
- The console request route renders `sys_approval_request` under any app: the route asks its own object by name, as the inbox's record links (`recordHref`, `/apps/CURRENT/OBJECT/record/ID`) already relied on.

## Tests

<details><summary>New pins (top-level describes in existing harnesses)</summary>

- `RecordDetailView.topBar-27524.test.tsx`, describe "the breadcrumb while the record is read": (1) with the read held open, the crumb's current entry is `Lead` and the crumb has no `#`; after the read lands, `Record r-1`. (2) Opened from a list with siblings, `j` steps to `r-2` whose read is held open: the crumb reads `Lead`, not `Record r-1`; after it lands, `Record r-2`.
- `ApprovalsInboxPage.opensServedPage-12484.test.tsx`: the old pin "a row of the queue opens under the owner app" is now "a row of the queue opens in the app the inbox is mounted in, though another app owns the record" (expects `/apps/probe_app/...`); new: "a row of the queue whose object no app lists stays in the inbox's app, never Setup". The deep-link cases (owner app, else Setup) are unchanged and green.
- `ApprovalsInboxPage.queueStepper-34586.test.tsx`, new describe "the queue stays in the app its inbox is mounted in": with another app owning the records and Setup present, the row opens under the inbox's app, each decision opens the next request there, and the last returns to the inbox.
- `approvalQueueAdvance-34586.test.tsx`, describe "the next request opens in the app the queue was opened from": from `/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/component/approvals/inbox`, decisions open `r2` then `r3` under `/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/sys_approval_request/record/…`, and the last decision returns to that inbox.

</details>

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

Through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. Item 1, at head `6403349b2e` (app-shell unchanged since `ed5125a20e`):

- Every test that reads `ApprovalsInboxPage` (28 vitest files across the console, app-shell, components and i18n), plus the route census tests `openPathObjectReaders-12811`, `homeRecoveryRedirectsFollowDeclaration-7373`, `noSetupMetadataLink-28578`, `affordanceGrantMap-12082`, `record-pointer-card-renderer`, `objectHostApp` and `RecordDetailView.topBar-27524`: Test Files 36 passed (36), Tests 317 passed (317); VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check`: no errors; then `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (derived): Test Files 171 passed, 2 skipped (173); VERDICT command-exit 0.

Item 3, at head `ed5125a20e`:

- The two touched app-shell test files: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 21 passed (21).
- Every test file that imports `RecordDetailView` under `ui/packages/app-shell` and `ui/apps/console`, plus the census tests: Test Files 103 passed (103), Tests 842 passed (842).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (source and `tsconfig.test.json`): no errors.

The Playwright spec `e2e/approvals-inbox-phone.spec.ts` reads the inbox's source; it runs in CI's Live E2E.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

- Crumb expression put back to `recordTitle || shortRecordId(…)`: blob `78c0e6869cba` to `904874a471fc`; the two new crumb pins fail (Tests 2 failed, 7 passed), restored to `78c0e6869cba`.
- Title unkeyed (`const recordTitle = heldRecordTitle?.title;`): blob `78c0e6869cba` to `045338037074`; exactly the step pin fails (Tests 1 failed, 8 passed), restored to `78c0e6869cba`.
- Item 1: `openRequest`'s in-app branch disabled (`appName && false ? …`), so rows go back through `requestPagePath`: blob `3af04169adb6` to `86b29115194d`; exactly the three in-app pins fail (Tests 3 failed, 14 passed across `opensServedPage-12484` and `queueStepper-34586`), restored to `3af04169adb6`.

Both tests import the module under test from source (`./RecordDetailView`, `./ApprovalsInboxPage`), so no build stands between the mutation and the run.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 1 reverses an earlier rule, for in-app inbox opens only, and the reversal is on record.** The rule "a request opens under the app that owns its record, else Setup" came from #32667 (landed by PR #32850, commit `5fb79bc010`): `objectHostAppSegment` and `requestPagePath`, pinned by `ApprovalsInboxPage.opensServedPage-12484`. **No maintainer ruling set that routing.** It came from that card's "Expected" line ("A request opens in the app that owns its record (or in a neutral approvals context)"), the dev's implementation (the Setup fallback is the dev's design), and the seat's ACCEPT (comment 6837076176). The only maintainer words in that chain are 「可以」 (relayed in comment 6837571290), which let a p2 card land while the ui lane took p1 only; they say nothing about routing. This card's maintainer approval (「你提的意见都同意，立卡」, on the parent coordinator card) names item 1 directly, is later, and is narrower: it covers opens from an app's own inbox. The earlier card's reported symptom was a Home / notification open, which is the deep link this PR leaves as it was. Its other concern, that the request page's record card could not reach the record, is held independently by the record card's owner-app link, which stays. Recorded in claim amendment 7009097779.
- **One side effect worth knowing:** Home's 「审批中心」 button opens the inbox under Home's host app (`/apps/HOST/system/approvals`), so a row opened from there now stays under HOST rather than moving to the record-owning app. Opening a single request from Home's list or a notification goes through the deep link and is unchanged.
- **Item 2 (opens with no source app) is unchanged**, and is now its own card, #35505. Today: Home 「我的工作 · 待审批」 and the notification popover open `/apps/HOST/system/approvals?request=ID` (HOST = the app the reader is in, else the first active app); an email or server notification link opens `/system/approvals?request=ID`, which forwards to `/apps/setup/system/approvals?request=ID`. Both then read the request and open it under the app that lists its record's object, else Setup. No app-less approval page is reachable on main: `/system/*` always forwards into the Setup app, and the app-less route set mounts only on a deployment with no apps.
- A record drawn in a list's pane (`recordDrawerStack`) still falls back to the short id when its level carries no title; that path has no loading state of its own and usually carries the row's title. Not changed.

## Verification

- Derived gate families (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 7 paths vs merge base `6f36818f0`) at `6403349b2e`: 39 derived, 39 run, each `exit 0`; `--ran`: "39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)".
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` at `86cde0c125` against origin/main `819c0679a8`: merges cleanly, no open PR head overlaps.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (ui): 0 new citations.
- `test:repo`, the generated-locale checks and the wide run belong to CI; this PR changes no locale keys.
- Two-minute check: in a business app with a 「待我审批」 menu entry, open a pending request. The app name and the left menu stay that app's, and the address reads `/apps/THAT_APP/sys_approval_request/record/…`. Approve it, and the next request opens in the same app. While each loads, the crumb reads 「审批请求」, never `#` and an id.
